verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents its own online corporation formation service (C corp option, a guarantee to correct filing errors, and pitched to founders raising from investors), so the filing part of the story is directly supported. Nothing in the evidence covers Delaware, bylaws, or initial board approvals; AI meeting minutes are an ongoing compliance feature, and the operating agreement is LLC-only, so neither counts here. Missing for 10: Delaware-specific incorporation evidence, bylaws generation, initial board consents/organizational resolutions, end-to-end online workflow detail, independent corroboration for corporations.

support.subject: As a founder, I can incorporate a Delaware startup end-to-end online, including the filing, bylaws, and initial board approvals
